linkedin.about:
Barbara Corcoran’s credits include straight D’s in high school and college and 20 jobs by the time she turned 23. It was her next job that would make her one of the most successful entrepreneurs in the country: She borrowed $1,000 and quit her job as a waitress to start a tiny real estate company in New York City. Over the next 25 years Barbara would parlay that $1,000 loan into a $5 billion real estate business, building the largest and best-known brand in the business. 
 
Corcoran is the author of the best seller “Shark Tales: How I Turned $1,000 into a Billion Dollar Business!” and host of top business podcast “Business Unusual with Barbara Corcoran” and lifestyle podcast “888-Barbara.” 
 
Corcoran is a motivational and inspirational speaker. She is a frequent small business and real estate contributor on every major network. Corcoran has been an investor/Shark for the past ten seasons on ABC's four-time Emmy award wining show, Shark Tank, investing in over 80 businesses to date. Follow Barbara on Twitter and Instagram @BarbaraCorcoran.

positions.description: Get the advice you need to live a better life! From the boardroom to the bedroom, nothing’s off limits. Utterly candid and totally unfiltered, Barbara Corcoran’s got the answers. Call 888-Barbara! I'm an answering machine.

"Shark Tank" is a business reality television series by acclaimed TV producer Mark Burnett that airs on ABC Network Fridays at 8|9c. As one of the “Sharks,” Barbara Corcoran and four other prominent executives listen to business pitches from everyday people who hope to launch their company or product to new heights. Investing her own money in every deal she makes, Barbara partners with entrepreneurs and helps them turn their dreams into reality. Millions of viewers tune into the show as Barbara shares her off the cuff and brash critiques along with entrepreneurial insights and business prowess.

I'm smart at getting where I want to go. On Business Unusual I give you the straight talk and confidence you need to get there through interviews, short stories, and listener Q&A. Got a question for me? Call 888-BARBARA and I just might answer on a future episode. Listen and subscribe on Apple Podcasts or wherever you listen to podcasts.

The Barbara Corcoran Venture Partners syndicate is accessed through AngelList, a platform that gives investors access to start-up and early-stage companies. The syndicate allows investors to invest with Barbara for as little as $1,000.
